scope: schemes1/2; after2026-08-07 through2026-10-19 local report files

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 충돌 계수·pressure shift·pump/probe homogeneous 폭 계약
findings.current_evidence: gabes/species.py:210-212 ignores iso and returns BETA_SELF*N. sas.py:456 adds self+Ne width to probe, while pump Hamiltonian/manifold retains natural decay + transit. constants.py:79 has fixed Ne broadening; pressure shift absent. Scalar Lambda Raman dephasing is not a sourced pressure law.
acceptance_criteria: 종·선·기체별 출처/단위/부호/불확도/유효범위, unsupported 상태.
pressure shift와 elastic optical dephasing 분리; OD/SAS pump/probe 공통 폭 계약.
buffer=0 기준 보존, 교정된 Cs/D2는 자체 근거로 검증.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 종·선·편광별 pump Rabi 규약과 잘못 표기된 비율 정정
findings.current_evidence: species.py:272-282 still uses constants.I_SAT for every line. probe_saturation.closed_two_level_saturation_intensity uses line wavelength/linewidth; this closed-two-level value alone does not establish the correct open/mF-averaged pump Rabi. Oct05 explicitly corrects Sep25 ratio direction: current/helper=0.431..0.610, not reciprocal.
acceptance_criteria: dipole/linewidth/편광/intensity/Hz↔rad 단위 계약 및 독립 two-level limit.
Sep25 reciprocal ratio 오류를 재채택하지 않음; thermal 흡수 정규화와 pump Rabi 검증 분리.
pump-off 기준 보존; pumped 교정은 자체 reference 비교.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ Lambda Doppler-off에서 beam angle이 스펙트럼을 바꾸는 결함
findings.current_evidence: Before patch, max|chi10mrad-chi0|/max|chi0| = 0.029420381963511447. absorption.py now passes optical-only scan_shift separately from atom.S_v residual Raman velocity shift. Compiled and NumPy fallback both fixed; cache_version advanced to physical-units-v4-independent-scan-shift.
acceptance_criteria: EIT/AT/CPT 모두 Doppler off의 0↔10mrad chi rtol1e-12, atol1e-14.
독립 explicit H11=Dc-s+r*kv, H22=-s+kv complex trace-one solve와 warm/cold parity.
findings.scope: cold-limit/operator 분리만 완료. 이 기존 item 전체 완료 아님; 2-D geometry·k mismatch·readout는 아래 open.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ EIT/CPT linewidth·group index 수렴 및 visibility gate
findings.current_evidence: LambdaScheme._scan remains uniform 601; window_fwhm uses sampled crossings; _metrics still emits numeric width/group index without sample/edge/experimental-visibility gates. Cold operator patch intentionally preserves the grid and readout.
acceptance_criteria: 중심집중 601 또는 bounded refinement; high-resolution reference와 FWHM/ng 2% 이내.
보간 half-height, ≥8 samples/FWHM, 각 crossing에서 scan edge까지 ≥1FWHM.
transmission·group delay 함께 출력, noise/contrast threshold 없으면 visibility not assessed.
기본 warm-JIT walltime 기존 대비 ≤20% 증가.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 실제 probe-coupling Δk와 2-D 공동 Maxwell 상관
findings.current_evidence: _two_photon_k_ratio passes identical medium[k_vec] to both beams, losing co-propagating frequency difference. atoms.lambda3 puts residual Raman and optical Doppler on the same v, not independent vz/vx. Cold patch removes spurious stationary-angle dependence but does not correct this warm geometry. Sept21 onward flags this separate problem; common doppler.noncollinear reference exists.
acceptance_criteria: 선택 transition의 signed kp-kc 및 thermal Gaussian analytic RMS 검증.
2-D joint quadrature의 grid/cutoff 수렴과 직접 Hamiltonian reference.
2-D는 opt-in reference부터; 정량 alignment tolerance 주장 제한.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ Lambda scalar medium·ground-coherence dephasing·slow-light 의미 명시
findings.current_evidence: absorption.py _medium_from_params selects dominant isotope line constants and abundance-weighted scalar density, not a hyperfine mixture. buffer_ground_relax_khz label/help says buffer collision although atoms.lambda3 applies generic ground-coherence decay. Module docstring still claims Gamma-unit controls; actual schema MHz/kHz. User Guide line606 calls dispersion slow-light signature without finite-pulse/low-transmission boundary.
acceptance_criteria: ground-coherence dephasing 의미·anchor Rabi·natural-Rb effective medium 명시.
MHz/kHz 문서 일치; local group index와 usable pulse delay·SNR·distortion 구분.
현재 기본값/모델/샘플링 상태 manifest 포함 EIT/AT/CPT 예제.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ Decadic absorbance와 natural optical depth의 이름·export 구분
findings.current_evidence: observables.optical_density returns alpha*L/ln(10). sas.py:860,870,972,984 still labels Optical density; precise -log10 definition exists internally but optical-depth alpha*L is not separately named/exported. This is semantic factor-ln10 risk, not an absorption/T physics error.
acceptance_criteria: A10=-log10(T), tau=-ln(T)=alpha L 명시, 기존 compatibility 의미 유지.
UI/export 양쪽에 convention와 단위 기록; tau=ln(10)*A10 independent fixture.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 열적 정규화의 독립 근거·versioned reference와 software-vs-experiment 경계
findings.current_evidence: Current species.line_integrated_alpha uses CF2/[2(2I+1)] without second pF. tests/test_sas.py:91..109 checks lifetime oscillator sums and degeneracy ratios for all 6 isotope/line combinations, ratio7/5 retained. External AutoOD-Rb source/baseline lies under ignored references/*. sas.py:358-359 still says lab AutoOD calculator <0.1%; guide lines409,563,922 repeat it. Internal ODScheme closure is not independent experimental validation.
acceptance_criteria: 현 열적 정규화/7:5 유지, source/hash/단위/비교조건 versioned fixture 보존.
internal closure, software reference, held-out measured validation을 명확히 분리.
About/Guide의 lab validation 오독 문구 교정; clean checkout에서 근거 재현.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ AutoOD 내부 closure test의 허용오차를 명시된 0.1%에 맞춤
findings.current_evidence: tests/test_sas.py:260-271 still asserts area and peak <0.01, while sas.info states <0.1%. Tighten only internal numerical closure, not claim external experimental validation.
acceptance_criteria: 동일 보정정규화 SAS↔ODScheme area/peak closure ≤1e-3.
테스트 이름/docstring은 내부 software closure 의미로 기록.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ SAS cache version7을 현 정규화 후 갱신하라는 과거 제안
findings.current_evidence: sas.py:220 now cache_version="8" (configurable Rb composition + stable centroid). Reports mentioning version7 are stale. Do not create redundant version bump absent a new compute semantic change.
acceptance_criteria: 현 cache8와 normalization/source provenance 함께 기록.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 이미 구현된 custom Rb isotope fraction과 새 원소 결정을 분리
findings.current_evidence: sas._isotope_composition and tests/test_od_isotope_ratio.py implement Custom normalized Rb85 fraction, fixed mixture reference centroid, endpoints, exact natural reproduction. Existing checklist still calls whole species menu fixed and needs_decision. Na/K data remain absent.
acceptance_criteria: Rb fraction 구현 부분 done과 tests/source 기록.
Na/K 신규 원소는 별도 needs_decision; hyperfine/dipole/vapor/saturation/collision 근거 전 노출 금지.
decision_required: 추가 alkali 원소 및 대상 실험 수요 선택

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ OD/SAS·Lambda Guide/그림/실행 예제 동기화
findings.current_evidence: Guide:573 says 0mW and natural-Rb-D2-only finite probe, whereas schema exposes 0..100uW for built-in Rb/Cs D1/D2 with tiers. Custom isotope and Fit alignment workflows absent. OD/SAS/EIT/AT static assets predate current defaults/normalization; EIT title old Ωc6MHz,γgg10kHz vs current17.238MHz,57.46kHz. No standalone examples directory. Timing table ~0.6s has no current environment manifest.
acceptance_criteria: 현재 controls/units/model tier/weak finite probe scope/CSV calibration·sweep·alignment 반영.
그림에 입력/commit/source hash/cache/grid/status 기록; CPT 포함.
실행 가능한 bounded headless script/config/CSV 제공; 당시 성능 조건 명시.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 코팅 셀 figure/export의 population-only·T1 참조 표기
findings.current_evidence: sas.py raw has paraffin_coated/paraffin_t1_s and info explains T1 reference, but _obs_species figure title and derived readout do not consume either field. Saved figure can lose coated model provenance.
acceptance_criteria: figure/export에 coated, population-only, T1 reference와 cycle-rate 가정 기록.
기본 off/pump-off invariance 유지; cell-specific validation 전 semi-quantitative 유지.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 정량 lock·linewidth export의 고정창 수렴 상태 보존
findings.current_evidence: subdoppler_feature correctly demotes unresolved default and tests/test_sas.py holds fixed-window refinement. Reports correctly distinguish this status gate from default-grid convergence. Current 1401 default remains resolution-limited; do not reopen completed core readout as absent.
acceptance_criteria: 기존 hero gate 유지; 정량 export에 feature window/grid/refinement comparison 기록.
bounded local refinement 또는 4001점 등 실제 수렴값 확보 후 numeric lock/linewidth 사용.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ OD/SAS dense velocity arithmetic와 exact scalar/finite-probe 재사용
findings.current_evidence: _component_response builds scan×velocity arrays and repeatedly interpolates levels. sas.py:1070 helper always computes prepared_population*profile even scalar1; lines690..700 repeat thermal matvec for pump-off finite probe. Both micro-optimizations structurally valid; no code changed this pass.
acceptance_criteria: 먼저 scalar1 direct matvec와 thermal_alpha=transition_alpha exact guard.
fused loop는 1m/s·4σ measure, Γ/8 pump table, np.interp boundary·velocity/transition summation 보존.
흡수/분산/코팅/finite-probe Numba on/off parity·시간·peak memory 검증; 3× 목표 실측 전 단정 금지.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ Legendre node cache·per-frequency inversion loop의 작은 성능 후보
findings.current_evidence: probe_saturation.py:195 calls leggauss(radial_order) each readout; frequency inversion uses Python np.interp loop at236. Runtime benefit must be measured in finite-probe workload; not a physical correction.
acceptance_criteria: order-key readonly nodes/weights, 같은 inversion/interp semantics.
전파 T/effective alpha parity와 실제 readout 성능 개선 확인.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ Lambda pole port·sparse affine update·BLAS controller 재사용
findings.current_evidence: Lambda still executes affine scan/velocity LU. core.blas_single_thread repeatedly discovers threadpools; kernels._affine_scan_chi_real rewrites dense coefficients. Reports claim ~1.8× pole and ~1.19× controller candidate; these historical timings are not new validation.
acceptance_criteria: P1 operator/geometry semantics 뒤 finite discrete Maxwell measure·per-row guard 보존.
continuous Gaussian 도입은 measure 변경으로 따로 기록.
BLAS controller는 nested context/thread/process safety 검증; sparse update는 independent parity/benchmark.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 이미 완료된 pump-off solve skip·CSV median·line-strength cache·running median
findings.current_evidence: sas._component_response branches pump_off and skips pump solve; _csv_numeric.sort_and_median_duplicates vectorizes duplicates; Lambda line_strength recompute=False and live readout test exist; lineshape.subdoppler_feature uses sliding_window_view. Zero-profile FFT shortcut and headless/real-basis paths exist. Re-registering them as missing would duplicate work.
acceptance_criteria: 기존 회귀 유지.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 이미 완료된 OD 분산·분리온도·코팅·CSV 의미 보존
findings.current_evidence: Current raw/observables plus tests implement complex-profile dispersion, density/Doppler temperature toggle, population reservoir, relative/absolute calibration and acquisition-order sweep branches. These are not absent features.
acceptance_criteria: 현재 제한 범위 유지; figure/export/guide 누락은 별도 findings에서 처리.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 보존된 CSV forward/reverse branch를 비교 UI에서 선택·overlay
findings.current_evidence: experimental_csv preserves branches; merged comparison warns about hysteresis but full per-direction selection is not a scientific requirement for current basic overlay. Current Fit alignment is affine alignment, not physical parameter fitting.
acceptance_criteria: branch selector/overlay 필요시 acquisition order/sample count 보존; heavy solve0.
findings.activation_trigger: bidirectional hysteresis 비교를 실제 사용 workflow로 선택

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ VCC·hyperfine/Zeeman·coated transport·segmented pump·physical spectrum fit
findings.current_evidence: Compact F-state/3-level and uniform-pump models omit these dynamics. Existing fitting/segmentation acceptance has identifiability, holdout and convergence conditions. Affine Fit alignment does not complete physical parameter inference. Coating population memory cannot be copied to Lambda coherence.
acceptance_criteria: 기존 ready fitting/segmentation 수용기준 유지.
parked model은 선택 transition/kernel/geometry·calibration/holdout·runtime budget 확보 후 opt-in.
findings.activation_trigger: 각 기존 item의 대상/측정자료/예산 조건 충족

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 검증 없는 low-order 편광·Zeeman/Dicke·코팅 proxy 즉시 도입
findings.current_evidence: These suggestions add unidentified fit freedom without fixing omitted dynamics. Reports themselves preserve prior rejection/parked policy; no new data or physical derivation establishes a changed basis.
acceptance_criteria: 기각 유지; 독립적으로 식별 가능한 근거가 생기면 별도 제안.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 느려진 naive interpolation vectorization·단순 affine hoist 강제
findings.current_evidence: Aug26 Lambda prototype was0.985× (slower) despite parity; later reports do not establish consistent gain for simple hoist. Coated/population all-level gathered interpolation increases memory/time. Sparse kernel update remains separately benchmarkable; claim universal speedup is unsupported.
acceptance_criteria: 현 기각 후보를 무조건 구현하지 않음; 새 end-to-end profiling 근거가 있을 때만 재평가.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 추가 immutable atom/angular cache·coated multi-RHS
findings.current_evidence: species.build_manifold already bounded LRU; medium/atom construction is <1% default EIT cost in reports. Coated multi-RHS could share an operator but trace injection/conditioning need verification and overall gain is small. No urgency.
acceptance_criteria: 대표 workload 병목 증거·readonly 반환·conditioning/trace invariant·end-to-end gain 확보.
findings.activation_trigger: 반복 batch 또는 cold scan에서 해당 단계가 실제 병목으로 실측됨

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 오래된 49/25·raw hash·실험검증 표현을 correctness oracle로 복원
findings.current_evidence: Historical49/25 double-counts ground population; current independent lifetime/degeneracy tests require7/5. Byte-exact reference SHA hash is platform-sensitive; numerical and analytic tolerance gates are needed. In-repo AutoOD closure does not validate external measurement.
acceptance_criteria: 수학/단위/출처가 독립인 numeric anchors와 uncertainty-aware held-out checks 유지.

findings.title: ⟦AI⟧ 자동 리뷰의 공통 test 수집·문서·Windows capsule 실패 정리
findings.current_evidence: Old ignored reference sympy collection failures partly addressed by pytest.ini --ignore=archive/AutoOD. Current stale ReferenceOD path is being patched by root (references/AutoOD -> archive/AutoOD). Oct Lambda reports record Windows nested-capsule FileNotFoundError and utcnow deprecation, not Lambda physics failures. Root full-suite result owns final classification.
acceptance_criteria: 현재 전체 수트로 재확인; 과거 실패 횟수를 새 physics defect처럼 중복 등록하지 않음.
고정 portable fixture 경로·선택 dependency 수집 경계; 실제 남은 capsule 실패만 별도 추적.
